title: Shipwright Fallback Policy
description: Config-driven policy for high-impact runtime fallbacks with adaptive override support. Resolved by _smart_fallback in scripts/lib/fallback-policy.sh. Precedence: env SW_<KEY> > daemon-config.json .fallback_overrides.<key> > learned adaptive override (clamped, gated on learning_enabled + confidence) > policies[key].static > hardcoded call-site default.

policies.description: Map of dot-path policy key (e.g. network.gh_timeout) to its declaration.

static.description: Static policy value. Must equal the original call-site literal for behavior-preserving migration.

adaptive_range.description: Inclusive [min, max] bounds. Learned overrides are clamped to this range so learning can never violate an invariant (e.g. timeout to 0).

learning_enabled.description: When false (GA default), the adaptive override tier is skipped entirely.

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum confidence (0-1) a learned override must carry before it is applied.

metric_source.description: Documentation pointer to the sw-adaptive metric that feeds this policy.

context.description: Human-readable description of what this fallback controls.
